name: The Vigilante: Single Shot Justice
source:
The Vigilante: Single Shot Justice is an interactive visual mystery novel. In it, you play as a vigilante trying to stop a murder that she know is going to happen.

[From [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-28/comment-page-4/?action=preview&uid=3595]Ludum Dare[/url]]

《义警：一发正义》是一部互动视觉推理小说。你将扮演一名义警，试图阻止一场她知道必然会发生的谋杀。
